title: Fix category display to show all categories in responsive grid

requirements.summary: Modify the category filter bar to display all categories in a responsive grid layout that wraps to multiple rows
acceptanceCriteria: All categories (22-23) are visible on screen without requiring horizontal scroll
Categories wrap to new rows when they reach the edge of the screen
Layout remains responsive across different screen sizes
No categories are hidden off-screen to the right

file_operations.description: Replace the horizontal scrolling flex container with a responsive grid layout that wraps categories to multiple rows. Change the container from 'flex overflow-x-auto' to 'grid grid-cols-[repeat(auto-fill,minmax(140px,1fr))] gap-2' to enable wrapping behavior. Ensure all category buttons and action buttons (Favorites, Create Category) use consistent sizing and maintain their visual appearance while fitting within the grid layout.

requirements.summary: Ensure the category grid appears directly below the search bar with proper button ordering
acceptanceCriteria: Category section appears immediately below the search bar
Favorites button appears first in the layout
All user categories follow after these two buttons
All items maintain consistent visual spacing and alignment

file_operations.description: Review the layout structure to verify that the CategoryFilterBar component is positioned immediately below the SearchInput component without extra spacing. Ensure the component hierarchy and spacing between search and category sections is minimal and consistent.

Verify and maintain the button rendering order: Favorites button first, Create Category button second, followed by all user categories. Ensure all buttons within the grid use consistent padding, height, and visual styling so they align properly in the responsive grid layout.
